answer: According to Section 43 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, the right of private defence against house-breaking continues as long as the house-trespass is ongoing. This means that if someone unlawfully enters your house at night with the intent to steal, you have the right to defend yourself and your property. Additionally, Section 41(d) states that if there is a reasonable apprehension of death or grievous hurt due to theft or house-trespass, the right of private defence extends to causing harm other than death. Therefore, you are justified in using private defence in such a situation.
summary_answer: Yes, you can use private defence if someone entered your house at night to steal.
